patterns.title: Button Pattern
patterns.what: A button is a widget that enables users to trigger an action or event. Prefer <button> over role="button" on a div.
patterns.how_to_meet: Use the native <button> element. If you must use role="button", add tabindex="0", handle both click and keydown for Enter and Space, and add aria-pressed for toggle buttons. The button has an accessible name from its text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.
patterns.common_failures: <div onClick> without role/tabindex/keyboard handlers; button with no accessible name; toggle button without aria-pressed.

patterns.title: Link Pattern
patterns.what: Links navigate to a new resource. Buttons perform an action on the current page. Choose by the semantic intent, not the visual style.
patterns.how_to_meet: Use <a href="…"> for navigation. The link text describes the destination. For icon-only links, add aria-label. Avoid <a> without href (it's not focusable and doesn't behave like a link).
patterns.common_failures: <a> used as a button (no href); 'click here' link text; icon link with no aria-label.

patterns.title: Dialog (Modal) Pattern
patterns.what: A modal dialog interrupts the workflow to focus on a single task and traps focus until dismissed.
patterns.how_to_meet: Use the native <dialog> element with showModal() where possible. Otherwise: role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby pointing at the heading. Move focus to the dialog on open, restore to the trigger on close. Trap Tab inside, Escape closes.
patterns.common_failures: Focus left on the trigger after open; no focus trap; close button has no accessible name; Escape doesn't close.

patterns.title: Form Label Pattern
patterns.what: Every form control has a programmatically associated label.
patterns.how_to_meet: Wrap inputs with <label> or use <label for="input-id">. For groups, use <fieldset><legend>. For composite controls (e.g. a search bar with icon button), use aria-labelledby. Placeholder is not a label.
patterns.common_failures: Visible label not associated with the input; placeholder used instead of label; search input labelled only by an icon.

patterns.title: Image Pattern
patterns.what: Images need a text alternative unless they're decorative.
patterns.how_to_meet: Informative has alt describing what the image conveys. Decorative has alt="" (explicit empty). Functional images (icon-buttons) describe the action. CSS background images that convey meaning need an aria-label on the parent or visually-hidden text.
patterns.common_failures: Missing alt; alt="image.png"; decorative image with alt="decorative"; SVG without title or aria-label.

patterns.title: Landmark Regions
patterns.what: Landmarks identify the major regions of a page so screen reader users can jump between them.
patterns.how_to_meet: Use <header>, <nav>, <main>, <aside>, <footer>. One <main> per page. Name multiple <nav>s via aria-label ("Primary", "Footer"). Avoid wrapping everything in <main>.
patterns.common_failures: Two <main> regions; no <main> at all; multiple <nav>s without distinguishing labels.

patterns.title: Live Regions
patterns.what: Live regions announce dynamic content updates to assistive tech without moving focus.
patterns.how_to_meet: Use role="status" (polite) for success messages and aria-live="assertive" or role="alert" for errors. The region must exist in the DOM before content is inserted. For frequent updates (timers, search-as-you-type), debounce so announcements don't spam.
patterns.common_failures: Live region created at the same time as the message (announcement is missed); aria-live="assertive" on a frequently-changing region.

patterns.title: Focus Management
patterns.what: Focus moves predictably when content changes, and the focused element is always visible.
patterns.how_to_meet: On route change in an SPA, move focus to the main heading or main landmark. After closing a dialog, restore focus to the element that opened it. Style :focus-visible with a clear 3:1-contrast indicator; never use outline:none without a replacement. Sticky headers should leave enough scroll-margin so they don't cover the focused element.
patterns.common_failures: outline:none with no replacement; SPA navigation that leaves focus on the previous link; modal closed and focus jumps to <body>.
